edition.notes: A dated delivery state of a public-domain nineteenth-century translation on a copyrighted host, keeping the printed chapter numbering and chapter titles. The Buffalo printing itself is registered in this library as an anthology container with a tracked OCR artifact; the same wording was read there for chapters 8 and 9, and neither was collated against a facsimile.
edition.publication: New Advent web presentation of the translation printed in The Ante-Nicene Fathers, volume 1 (Buffalo: Christian Literature Publishing Company, 1885), complete text retrieved 2026-07-25
edition.title: The Second Apology, English (Ante-Nicene Fathers vol. 1) — New Advent web state

alternate_titles: Second Apology of Justin for the Christians
work.author: Justin Martyr
work.description: The shorter apology transmitted under Justin's name, addressed to the Roman senate, conventionally divided into fifteen chapters. Its relation to the First Apology is disputed among editors, some treating it as an appendix to that work rather than an independent piece, and the chapter order differs between the principal manuscript and some modern editions.
work.title: Apologia secunda
